messages:
liz: MedNexus RFP just landed — support ticket #8732. They require SOC2 Type II evidence, HIPAA BAA, audit logs retained 7 years, and an on-demand export for audits. Questionnaire attached. Need triage + backlog bucket.
amanda: @liz thanks — can you paste the key asks? Any legal redlines already?
liz: Pasted bullets from the form: 1) Retention window = 7 years for audit logs, 2) Immutable / tamper-evident logs, 3) SAML + SCIM for user provisioning, 4) On-demand evidence pack (PDF + raw logs), 5) Data residency EU-only. Sales flagged as enterprise.
ben: @amanda @raj high priority. ACV ~$800k ARR if we close. Sales needs clarity on timeline and whether Private deployment will be required.
tracy: From security: 7y is longer than our current default (1y). We can provide export today for recent data but not immutable 7y retention. Need to scope: are they asking for request-level logs only or full model input/response logs + KV cache entries? Also confirm KMS/HSM requirements.
raj: Engineering constraints: 7y retention implies extra storage + indexing and retention policies. Roughly 2–3w infra work + 1 sprint infra + 2 sprints API/packaging if we build full flow. Need to know preferred format (raw JSONL vs zipped archives).
amanda: Proposed path: (1) Quick win: ship an 'evidence pack' export for up to 1y (automated) and offer manual support-assisted exports for older data (up to 7y) — ETA 3 business days for demo. (2) Backlog epic: 'Long-term retention & export' with acceptance criteria and cost estimate. Can Sales accept interim?
ben: Sales says interim is acceptable if we commit to roadmap and an estimated ETA in the contract. They want a canary/commitment.
tracy: Compliance note: For HIPAA we also need a signed BAA; legal must sign off before any PHI transfer. Also we'll need audit of access to exported evidence.
liz: Quick Q: what's minimum payload for the evidence pack that we can ship as a demo to them?
amanda: Example JSON bundle for the evidence pack: ```{ "customer_id": "cust_123", "requested_by": "mednexus_audit@mednex.com", "logs": [ {"ts": "2024-06-01T12:00:00Z", "event": "request", "user_id": "u_456", "model": "redwood-1", "tokens_in": 512, "tokens_out": 128} ] }```
raj: For implementation I'd propose an API endpoint: `GET /v1/customers/:id/evidence?from=YYYY-MM-DD&to=YYYY-MM-DD&format=jsonl` that streams a zip. Quick prototype possible in 1 week. Full long-term retention requires DB schema + lifecycle job for immutability.
secbot: jira ticket created: INF-3245 "Evidence export - MedNexus" assignee: @raj
amanda: I'll scope an epic with launch criteria: - Export API available and documented - Example evidence pack (JSON/PDF) - Manual process for 7y requests with SLA to support - Legal signoff for BAA - Storage cost estimate and billing notes. Target: milestone M2 with canary.
ben: Can we offer Private deployment as an accelerated option? That would cover EU residency quickly for this customer.
tracy: Private helps residency but doesn't automatically enforce immutable retention; we'd need config (WORM/retention policy) and verification. Also need evidence of immutable storage (object-lock or similar).
amanda: Action items: @liz confirm customer accepts interim 1y automated export + manual 7y exports; @ben get legal contact for BAA; @raj provide rough effort/estimate; @tracy list compliance blockers that block signoff. I'll mark priority = P1 if ACV confirmed.
liz: Confirmed — MedNexus accepts interim 1y automated export + manual 7y for now. They've signed NDA and asked for a formal ETA.
jira-bot: INF-3245 linked to EPIC INF-3300 "Compliance evidence & retention"
amanda: Thanks all — I'll update roadmap board and spin up PRD draft with acceptance criteria and cost/risk notes. Ping me for clarifications. :thumbsup:
